name: Workflows
description: Lists of steps you repeat, per project — a release, a deploy, a morning routine. Jig does the steps it can, asks first, or leaves them to you; on a schedule while Jig is open; export as a Claude Code skill or move to the cloud.

tools.description: Save a repeatable multi-step process as a workflow in the project (or update the one with that name). Steps: strings, or {title, kind: check|command|script|pipeline|claude|wait, mode: auto|ask|manual, command?, prompt?}; a 'claude' step is a message for Claude.
